output_contract.candidate_ids: 1 to 3 unique IDs from visible candidate_ontology

metric_contract.candidate_recall: sum true-positive gold candidates / total gold candidates
metric_contract.candidate_precision: sum true-positive emitted candidates / total emitted candidates
metric_contract.exact_set_rate: fixtures whose emitted set equals gold set
metric_contract.propagation_materiality: absolute layer-local recall minus actual-S1 recall >= 0.20

candidate_ontology.a1: create or retain a claim-level exposure representing potential liability
candidate_ontology.a2: treat exposure as workplace sunlight exposure
candidate_ontology.a3: request clarification because the meaning of exposure is unresolved
candidate_ontology.a4: discard the liability concept and close the claim
candidate_ontology.a5: link the exposure to the relevant claim liability context
candidate_ontology.a6: reclassify the task as workplace-safety assessment

candidate_ontology.a1: hold payment until valid authorization exists
candidate_ontology.a2: obtain or route for the missing payment authorization
candidate_ontology.a3: issue payment because a reserve estimate already exists
candidate_ontology.a5: treat premium-customer status as payment authority

candidate_ontology.a1: request evidence or clarification that disambiguates which owner is meant
candidate_ontology.a2: preserve the owner referent as unresolved until disambiguating evidence arrives
candidate_ontology.a3: bind owner to policy owner immediately
candidate_ontology.a4: bind owner to task owner immediately
candidate_ontology.a6: change the goal to continue without clarification

candidate_ontology.a6: classify every failure as user error

candidate_ontology.a2: preserve the unverified chat as non-authoritative conflicting evidence
